_about: The TSG Helpdesk on AWS, as the platform team's first draft describes it. This is the course's own summary format (one file instead of a dozen consoles), not an AWS API body: each key names the real setting and the lesson that teaches it. Harden it, then run: make cloud (python3 cloud/cloud_check.py). Keys starting with _ are notes.

app_role._lesson: 10.3, 11.1: the IAM role the Helpdesk backend runs as
app_role.name: tsg-helpdesk-app

model_access._lesson: 10.3: which foundation models the account allows (organization policy or SCP allow-list)

invocation_logging._lesson: 11.4, 16.1: model invocation logging is off until you turn it on

cloudtrail._lesson: 16.1: Converse and InvokeModel are management events; knowledge base Retrieve and AgentCore runtime calls are data events

knowledge_base._lesson: 13.1: per-user or per-tenant metadata filters on Retrieve, set by your backend

agentcore_gateway._lesson: 14.3 to 14.5: the gateway in front of the crm MCP tools

secrets._lesson: 3.7, 11.3: what is in the prompt and in plain environment variables

detection._lesson: 16.2: GuardDuty AI Protection finding types all default to Low

budget._lesson: 0.7, 10.5: an AWS Budgets alert on the learning account

network._lesson: 11.2: an interface VPC endpoint for bedrock-runtime, with an endpoint policy
